# STYLE-11: A repeated or tricky condition becomes a named predicate

- A test made in more than one place, or easy to get wrong, becomes a `const` bool method named for what it decides, so a fix lands once.

Confirmed 2026-11-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Code Style](../claude/CLAUDE.md#code-style). [All rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
